PROVISIONAL_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL. +Bloodletter of Aclazotz +Unlicensed Disintegration +Tergrid, God of Fright +Purphoros, God of the Forge +Fiery Confluence +Tectonic Giant / -Death in Heaven -Weeping Angel -The Cyber-Controller -Blasphemous Act -Vandalblast -Swan Song. 34 lands and colour sources unchanged (U19 B18 R18), average nonland MV 3.231, 23 instants/sorceries, 25 creatures, 6 Game Changers (+Tergrid). Spellbook: 0 included combos. Commander-first for Davros's own end-step Oracle: more ways to make every opponent lose 3+ life on our turn (Bloodletter doubling, Purphoros per Dalek/myriad token, Fiery Confluence, Tectonic Giant, Disintegration) and a punisher (Tergrid) for the sacrifice/discard options of Davros's villainous choice, Court of Ambition, Torment of Hailfire and Perforating Artist. Losses: the one-sided artifact sweep (Vandalblast overload), Blasphemous Act's cheap symmetrical wipe, Swan Song's 1-mana counter, Weeping Angel's 3-mana flash body, The Cyber-Controller and Death in Heaven's grindy value.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (five-swap, staged, not selected). The preferred six without Tectonic Giant, keeping Swan Song. Keeps a 1-mana protection counter for Davros and engines; loses a repeatable 3-to-each-opponent attack trigger (6 with Bloodletter) that qualifies the whole table before blocks. Swan Song also gives the opponent a 2/2 flyer, a second blocker against menace. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (six-swap, staged). Keeps Blasphemous Act as a reset and cuts Ashad, the Lone Cyberman instead. Ashad's casualty copies of nonlegendary artifact spells (Roaming Throne naming Alien or Scientist, Auton Soldier, Dalek Squadron) multiplies Davros end-step triggers and keeps the artifact count for Unlicensed Disintegration and Mox Opal; Blasphemous Act kills our own Daleks and Davros. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (six-swap, staged). Pass C's paired cuts: Fiery Confluence over Weeping Angel and Unlicensed Disintegration over This Is How It Ends, keeping Vandalblast. This Is How It Ends is itself a villainous-choice card that can make one opponent lose 5 (twice with The Valeyard); Vandalblast is the more replaceable slot once Fiery Confluence keeps an artifact-destroy mode. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (seven-swap, staged). The preferred six plus Ingenious Artillerist over Sycorax Commander (Pass C's Artillerist pairing). The bounded test shows Artillerist qualifies all opponents only on 3+ artifact entries in one turn and dies to any ping (3/1); Purphoros covers the role at 2 per creature and is indestructible; Sycorax's discard-all/damage choice is Davros fuel. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (seven-swap, staged). The preferred six plus Flame Rift over Ashad. Flame Rift is 4 to every player (ourselves included), one-shot and redundant with Boltwave and Fiery Confluence; Ashad multiplies Davros triggers. MODERATE confidence.
